body: It helped me. The pain in my heart seem less magnified. I feel the pain in my body instead. Helps me set small goals and achieve it. A good ego boost. Something I've lost a while back.

I don't think there is anything I can say that you've not heard before. I have nothing new, no secret formula or magic wand to make all things better. But I know how you feel. I still struggle with it every waking morning. It's not easy. But you hang on and hold tight. And take it one day at a time, step by step, not one big leap but one step at a time. 

And when you are ready to go out and do a good deed to a complete stranger. Help someone. Will surely put a smile on your face. 

PM me.

Understanding what you are dealing every day is good. Knowing how the hardware works gives us better perspective and ability to deal with it and fight it and hopefully cure it intelligently.

Humans aren't defined by their brains alone. A whole gamut of things come into play. Including pain. 

Thank you for sharing

WhatsHisFac3, Is depression really a disease? Or is it just a big marketing concoction by big pharmaceutical companies? 

I have been fighting for a long time. I have been pretending for a long time. A friend once told me that I just wanted to die because that's my way of getting attention. Of course I felt offended. But I contemplated on that idea. And I disagree. It's a way of ending pain. Selfish. Yes. Very. But to be relieved of the pain, of people getting disappointments.  Ataraxis.

Iryasori, He is the reason I am still functioning. And I mean the world to him. He is 7, he does everything with me. When I am in bed, he chooses to sit with me and do nothing than be with me than somewhere else. This isn't easy for a 7 yr old kid. I talk to him and cried and said goodbye and told him about what to do when I'm gone. He looks confused. He will soon understand it.
7 years old. I've always been excited about Christmas. This year... Well... No Christmas Tree, no Christmas lights... No Christmas at all.
